messages:
Alex: Hey team — first week here. Just got my MacBook (M2) and trying to bootstrap dev env. Goals: python, node, go via asdf; Homebrew under /opt/homebrew; direnv; ssh into a prod jump host (ProxyJump). Hitting a few snags: asdf plugin-add golang fails with 'plugin not found', brew not on PATH after install, and the corporate VPN is forcing some registry env vars. Any quick tips?

Priya: welcome! :tada: quick wins: add brew to PATH in ~/.zprofile (if you're on zsh):

```
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"
eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"
```

Also put asdf init in your shell rc: `source ~/.asdf/asdf.sh` and `source ~/.asdf/completions/asdf.bash` (or the fish/zsh variants).

Sam: for the SSH jump host, add a snippet to ~/.ssh/config so you don't type the full proxy each time:

```
Host internal-* 
  User alex
  ProxyJump jump.prod.example.com
  ForwardAgent yes
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_redwood
```

Make sure the jump's host key is in known_hosts (or use `ssh-keyscan` to append).

Alex: thanks — when I run `asdf plugin-add golang` it prints: `ERROR: plugin not found: golang`. I can see `golang` in the asdf plugins list on the repo though. Is there a way to point asdf at the repo?

DevBot: If the plugin index lookup fails you can add by repo URL: `asdf plugin-add golang https://github.com/kennyp/asdf-golang.git`. Also try `asdf plugin-update --all` if plugins are stale. Commands I usually run: 

```
brew install asdf direnv
asdf plugin-add python
asdf install python 3.11.4
asdf global python 3.11.4
asdf plugin-add nodejs https://github.com/asdf-vm/asdf-nodejs.git
asdf install nodejs 18.16.0
asdf global nodejs 18.16.0
asdf plugin-add golang https://github.com/kennyp/asdf-golang.git
asdf install golang 1.21.6
```

Also if nodejs plugin needs gpg keys, run the nodejs import step from the plugin readme.

Laura: about the VPN/registry stuff — we expose a couple of env vars for internal Docker/registry access. Don't commit them to dotfiles; use direnv to load them locally. Example ~/.envrc: 

```
export REDWOOD_INTERNAL_REGISTRY="registry.internal.redwood.com"
export NO_PROXY="localhost,127.0.0.1,.internal.redwood.com"
layout python
use node
```

Then `direnv allow` in your repo root. If you need to share a sanitized template, put `.envrc.template` in the repo and add instructions in README.

Alex: ok tried `asdf plugin-add golang https://github.com/kennyp/asdf-golang.git` and it worked. Brew path fix also good. Quick Q: where should I put SSH key perms instructions for new hires?

Priya: we have a short doc in the handbook but ping `@infra-team` in #help for a copy. Main points: chmod 600 on private keys, add public key to your profile, use `ssh-add --apple-use-keychain` on macs if you want keychain persistence.

Sam: optional: if you use `git` over SSH behind the jump host, consider adding `Host github.com
  ProxyJump jump.prod.example.com` so pushes go through the jump.

Alex: perfect — thanks everyone, that unblocked me. I'll tidy up a short checklist and drop it in #new-hires so future folks can follow. :pray:
